name: Attizaz Sales Booster for WooCommerce
author: mriaz300

sections.description:
Attizaz Sales Booster for WooCommerce helps you sell more units per order with quantity-based “Buy More, Save More” pricing. Set up tiers like Buy 1, Buy 2 – 10% off, Buy 3 – 15% off, and the plugin shows a clean, conversion-focused widget right on the product page. When a customer adds a qualifying quantity to the cart, the discount is applied automatically — no coupon codes required.

It’s perfect for increasing average order value on consumables, apparel, accessories, and any product people tend to buy in multiples.

Why store owners love it

  • Increase average order value by rewarding customers for buying more.
  • No coupon codes to hunt for — savings are shown upfront and applied automatically.
  • A polished product-page widget that looks great out of the box.
  • Set it up in minutes, with a built-in live preview as you build.

Key features

  • Unlimited quantity discount tiers — “buy more, save more” pricing.
  • A clean, polished “Buy More, Save More” widget on the product page.
  • Two discount types: percentage off or a flat amount off.
  • Live preview while you build — see exactly what shoppers will see.
  • “Best Value” highlight, custom tier labels, and discount tags.
  • Advanced display options: show per-unit price, match the live (sale) price, show a compare-at strikethrough price, and control how out-of-stock options behave.
  • Discounts are applied as cart fees, keeping full compatibility with taxes, reports, and other plugins.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the cart/checkout blocks.
  • Translation-ready and lightweight.

How it works

  1. Create a Bundle Discount and add the products it applies to.
  2. Choose a discount type and add your quantity tiers (for example, Buy 2 = 10% off).
  3. Publish — the “Buy More, Save More” widget appears on those product pages.
  4. Customers pick a quantity, and the discount is applied automatically in the cart.

Premium version (separate plugin)

Attizaz Sales Booster Pro is a separate, optional plugin that adds more features on top of this free plugin. It is not required — this free plugin is fully functional on its own. Learn more at https://webstudio.attizazllc.com/bundle-discount/:

  • Category & store-wide targeting — apply an offer to entire product categories, or to all products at once.
  • Countdown timer — add urgency with multiple timer styles.
  • More widget styles & full color control — extra layouts, one-click color themes, and custom colors to match your brand.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Upload the attizaz-sales-booster-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  4. Go to “Bundle Discounts” in the admin menu and click “Add New” to create your first offer.
  5. Name your offer, add the products it applies to, set your quantity tiers, adjust any advanced options, then Publish.
sections.faq:
Does this work with any WooCommerce product?

Yes. Add one or more products to a bundle; the widget appears on those products’ pages and the tier discounts apply automatically in the cart.

Will the discount conflict with coupons or other pricing plugins?

Discounts are added as a negative cart fee rather than by editing product prices, which keeps things compatible with WooCommerce totals, taxes, and most other plugins.

Is it compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes, the plugin declares compatibility with HPOS and with cart/checkout blocks.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

Deleting the plugin removes all of its data: your bundle offers, their settings, and the custom database table. Deactivating (without deleting) keeps everything.
sections.changelog:
1.1.9

  • Removed leftover/unreachable code paths for features not present in this free plugin (a third discount type, category/store-wide targeting, countdown timer, color & style picker), so the admin UI and the underlying code now match exactly.
  • Fixed the “Advanced Settings” panel (show unit price, match live price, compare-at price, out-of-stock behavior) so it actually renders and takes effect — it was present in the code but not reachable in 1.1.8.
  • Fixed “Show Out-of-Stock Tiers”: the widget now renders on out-of-stock products (with options disabled) when this is turned on, instead of never rendering at all.
  • Removed a non-functional AJAX add-to-cart handler with no matching server-side action.
  • Hardened a direct database query to use identifier-safe escaping.

1.0.1

  • Renamed the plugin and updated branding. Removed unused code. No functional changes for existing offers.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: unlimited quantity discount tiers, live preview, advanced display options, and automatic cart discounts.
